html:
The Burma campaign was fought from 1942 to 1945. Japan conquered Burma in 1942, driving out the British, and Allied forces retook it in 1944 and 1945.

Japan was helped by the Burma Independence Army of Aung San. Hundreds of thousands of Indians fled on foot to India. Japan built the Burma Railway with forced labour.

After Japan's defeat at Imphal and Kohima in India, British and Indian armies under William Slim advanced, winning at Meiktila and taking Rangoon in May 1945. Aung San's army switched sides in March 1945. The war left Burma ruined and its many armed groups ready for the conflicts after independence. See Pacific War.
